Compute derivatives for BQ (MY)

Source: R/adult-MY-BQ.R
dMYdt.BQ.Rd

Implements dMYdt for the BQ ODE model.

# S3 method for class 'BQ'
dMYdt(t, y, xds_obj, s)

Arguments

t

current simulation time

y

state vector

xds_obj

an xds model object

s

the vector species index

Value

a numeric vector

State Variables

Bu

density of uninfected, blood-feeding mosquitoes

Qu

density of uninfected, gravid (egg-laying) mosquitoes

By

density of infected (exposed), blood-feeding mosquitoes

Qy

density of infected (exposed), gravid mosquitoes

Bz

density of infectious, blood-feeding mosquitoes

Qz

density of infectious, gravid mosquitoes

M

total adult mosquito density, derived during parsing

Y

total infected and infectious mosquito density, derived during parsing

Z

total infectious mosquito density, derived during parsing

Dynamical Terms

Lambda or \(\Lambda\)

adult mosquito emergence rate, computed by ramp.xds::Emergence

kappa or \(\kappa\)

net infectiousness, computed by ramp.xds::Transmission

Parameters

f

blood feeding rate — use ramp.xds::setup_f or ramp.xds::setup_blood_feeding_rates

q

human fraction — use ramp.xds::setup_q or ramp.xds::setup_human_fractions

g

mosquito mortality rate — use ramp.xds::setup_g or ramp.xds::setup_mosquito_mortality

sigma_b

emigration rate during blood feeding

sigma_q

emigration rate during egg laying

mu

fraction of emigrating mosquitoes lost

eip or \(\tau\)

extrinsic incubation period; \(\phi=1/\tau\)

nu or \(\nu\)

egg batch rate — use ramp.xds::setup_nu or ramp.xds::setup_egg_batch_rates

eggsPerBatch or \(\Gamma\)

number of eggs per batch

After basic setup, change_MY_pars.BQ can be used to change parameter values. Bionomic parameters are configured as static baselines by default.

Dynamics

Let \(\phi=1/\tau\), where \(\tau\) is the extrinsic incubation period. Mosquitoes move between blood-feeding and gravid states at rate \(f\) and oviposit at rate \(\nu\). Infection is acquired by uninfected blood-feeding mosquitoes; exposed mosquitoes progress to the infectious class at rate \(\phi\). The compartment equations are: $$ \begin{array}{rl} dB_u/dt &= \Lambda+\nu Q_u-fB_u-\Omega_b\cdot B_u \\\\ dQ_u/dt &= f(1-q\kappa)B_u-\nu Q_u-\Omega_q\cdot Q_u \\\\ dB_y/dt &= \nu Q_y-(f+\phi)B_y-\Omega_b\cdot B_y \\\\ dQ_y/dt &= fq\kappa B_u+fB_y-(\nu+\phi)Q_y-\Omega_q\cdot Q_y \\\\ dB_z/dt &= \phi B_y+\nu Q_z-fB_z-\Omega_b\cdot B_z \\\\ dQ_z/dt &= \phi Q_y+fB_z-\nu Q_z-\Omega_q\cdot Q_z \end{array} $$
